description:
You are an electrical engineering technician preparing a PCB board outline drawing for fabrication. Create a new drawing in LibreCAD with the following specifications. All coordinates are in millimeters with the board lower-left corner at the origin (0, 0).

Layer 1 — 'Board_Outline' (color: White, index 7):
- Draw a closed rectangle from (0, 0) to (100, 80) representing the board perimeter.

Layer 2 — 'Mounting_Holes' (color: Red, index 1):
- Draw 4 circles of diameter 3.2 mm (radius 1.6 mm) centered at:
  - (5, 5)
  - (95, 5)
  - (5, 75)
  - (95, 75)

Layer 3 — 'Keepout_Zone' (color: Yellow, index 2):
- Draw a closed rectangle from (10, 10) to (90, 70) representing the component placement boundary.

Save the completed drawing as: /home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/pcb_outline.dxf
